title: C-38: synthetic probe from connection through character select
notes: This is the currently executable prefix of the C-38 synthetic probe: the client connects, authenticates, receives the realm and character-list responses, and reaches character select.

The current repository has no world-entry, movement, or client-logout screens or driver actions. The later probe stages must extend this file when those protocol and reference surfaces land; this scenario deliberately does not invent them.
The included scenario already asserts the wrong-password retry, the successful authentication, the character-list exchange, a keepalive, and the character-select screen.

steps.name: the synthetic probe endpoint at character select
